BaseBridgeInvalidAmount: Below the minimum amount, or the quote has expired. Quote again and retry.
BaseBridgeInvalidValue: msg.value (or the transfer amount) differs from the expected value; the first argument is the expected value. Get a new quote.
BaseBridgeForwardAmountMismatch: The multihop equation (value + networkFee + exFee == hop-1 delivered amount) does not hold. Recompute from the last hop backwards.
BaseBridgeForwardStagedInsufficient: The hub's hop-2 network fee rose, so the quoted forward amount can no longer be met. Quote again with a hop2FeeBuffer.
BaseBridgeForwardNotOrigin: This token cannot be routed through the hub (an ERC20 must be the origin on both sides).
BaseBridgeForwardNotExecutor: bridgeTokenForwarded can only be called by the hub executor. Do not call it directly.
BaseBridgeForwardContextInactive: bridgeTokenForwarded can only be used inside extraData. Do not call it directly.
BaseBridgeInvalidRecipient: The recipient is the bridge contract itself.
BaseBridgeInvalidBalance: The bridge contract has insufficient balance (an operator-side liquidity issue).
RegistryNotExistToken: This token pair is not registered for the destination chain.
EnforcedPause: The bridge is paused for maintenance.
ERC20InsufficientAllowance: Insufficient allowance. The amount to approve is value + networkFee + exFee.
BETargetNotWhitelisted: The extraData target is not whitelisted on the executor (contact the bridge operator). The transfer is delivered as a plain transfer (fallback).
BEMethodNotWhitelisted: The extraData method is not whitelisted on the executor (contact the bridge operator). The transfer is delivered as a plain transfer (fallback).
BETargetCallFailed: The extraCall to the target failed. The transfer is delivered as a plain transfer (fallback).
BEOverspent: The extraCall spent more than the delivered amount. The transfer is delivered as a plain transfer (fallback).
CoreAmountBelowOneCoreWei: The HyperCore deposit amount is below 1 Core wei.
HyperMintableERC20CoreTokenIndexNotSet: This HyperEVM token is not linked to HyperCore yet (X2 unavailable).
SBRDeadlineExpired: The swap deadline has passed. Quote again.
SBRQuoteFailed: SwapBridgeRouter quote failed (see the QuoteStatus argument): NoPair / InsufficientForFee / InsufficientValue / InvalidSwap.
SBRInvalidAddress: tokenIn is not WCROSS, or an address is invalid.
SBRCircularPath: tokenIn and tokenOut are the same.
SBRPartialFill: A partial-fill remainder of a multihop swap was detected.
SafeERC20FailedOperation: ERC20 transfer failed (balance, allowance or token behaviour).
